TA0067.title: Recycler
TA0067.description:
A recycler is an intermediary in gray-market monetization chains who purchases, resells, or distributes arbitrage goods, virtual assets, accounts, and entitlements. They usually do not directly claim coupons, place orders, steal accounts, or perform attacks; instead, they provide upstream coupon abusers, scalpers, account brokers, or account-theft groups with a stable outlet, buying resources obtained through low-price purchase, malicious purchasing, benefit abuse, or account theft at a discount and reselling them at a markup.

In e-commerce and virtual-asset scenarios, recyclers monetize through second-hand platforms, offline dealers, social groups, live-streaming gift recycling channels, or cross-platform trades. Their direct risk is account-entitlement resale, account trading, and black-market goods circulation, while they indirectly increase the monetizability of upstream discount arbitrage, virtual-asset theft, and bulk purchasing.
